# Chicken Enchiladas Verdes

Rolled corn tortillas filled with poached chicken and blanketed in roasted tomatillo salsa, crema, and cheese.

## 🥘 Ingredients
- [ ] 2 lb bone-in chicken thighs
- [ ] 1 lb tomatillos, husked and rinsed
- [ ] 3 jalapenos, stemmed
- [ ] 1/2 white onion
- [ ] 3 cloves garlic
- [ ] 1 cup chicken broth
- [ ] 1 tsp kosher salt
- [ ] 12 corn tortillas
- [ ] 1 cup Mexican crema
- [ ] 2 cups shredded Oaxaca cheese
- [ ] 1/2 red onion, thinly sliced
- [ ] 1/4 cup chopped cilantro

## 🍳 Instructions
1. Simmer the chicken in salted water for 25 minutes until cooked through, then shred and set aside.
2. Char the tomatillos, jalapenos, onion, and garlic in a dry skillet until blistered.
3. Blend the charred vegetables with broth and salt until smooth, then simmer the salsa for 8 minutes.
4. Soften the tortillas in hot oil for 10 seconds each side and drain on paper towels.
5. Fill each tortilla with shredded chicken, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in a baking dish.
6. Pour the salsa verde over the enchiladas and scatter cheese on top.
7. Bake at 400 F for 15 minutes until bubbling, then finish with crema, red onion, and cilantro.
